job_description:
Join one of Montreal’s Top Employers in 2026. We are a leading international banking institution fully committed to building a more sustainable future.



Internship program



As an intern, you will benefit from a 4 month program that aims to give you the tools to develop yourself and discover your potential through customized trainings, networking sessions and transversal projects.



More information about the program available on our website:



BNP Paribas in Canada Students & Young graduates



The position at a glance



As an intern, you will assist the Head of Territory (HoT) and the COO with data collection, ad-hoc analyses, and special tasks, preparing presentations and documents for meetings, and supporting discussions with Operations to enhance reports related to Canadian client business.



In detail



This role will allow you to actively participate in developing data analysis and business reporting capabilities within the Canada CEO & COO Office. You will gain cross-functional knowledge of the various businesses within the Group and develop valuable skills:




- Data Analysis: You will use and enhance your data analysis skills with tools like Excel, PowerBI, Tableau, and ThinkCell.
- Project Management: You will learn to manage projects and priorities, monitor progress, report issues, develop action plans.
- Communication Skills: You will develop strong communication skills by presenting your findings to senior leadership and preparing detailed business reports.
- Professional Network: You will collaborate with multiple teams across the Bank, opening doors to future opportunities.
- Career Development: You will collaborate with multiple teams within the Bank, opening potentially leading to various career paths







Work conditions: This position provides for standard working conditions in an office and a normal work schedule from Monday to Friday.



The Strengths And Skills That Will Help You Succeed





- Student in a bachelor’s degree in business administration, communication, or other similar field of study
- Knowledge of Powerpoint
- Capacity to work with large dataset
- Knowledge of English and French, written and spoken*
- Given the vast majority of our clients, both internal and external, are based outside of Quebec and Canada, specific language requirements may apply. Professional working proficiency in French and English languages are required.







While the description above describes our ideal candidate, we encourage applicants to apply even if they do not fully meet the complete list of qualifications noted



Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) at the heart of our commitments



BNP Paribas is committed to fostering a work environment where all employees can feel heard, valued, safe and supported, and can be their authentic selves.



BNP Paribas recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, disability, age, and other protected status (Employment Equity Act and Canadian Human Right Act).



To learn more about our DE&I commitments, click here



About Us



BNP Paribas, the leading bank in the European Union and a major global financial institution, operates in 63 countries and has nearly 178,000 employees. Its mission is to foster a responsible, sustainable economy by financing and advising clients to the highest ethical standards while addressing environmental, regional development, and social inclusion concerns. With over 1,700 employees in Montreal and Toronto, BNP Paribas in Canada strives to develop long-term relationships with its clients by supporting their business strategies and meeting their financing and investment needs, both locally and abroad.



Our certifications and partnerships



Canada’s Top Employers for Young People 2026



Montreal’s Top Employers 2026



Canada’s Best Diversity Employers 2026



Women in Governance Platinum-Parity Certification



LinkedIn Top Companies 2024



What You Need To Know





- BNP Paribas is committed to accessibility and inclusion. During the recruitment process, accommodation needs are available at all times for candidates. You will have the chance to make a request for an accommodation during your application.

- You must be legally eligible to work in the Greater Montreal area and, if applicable, hold a valid work or study permit. Physical presence in BNP Paribas’ office(s) is an essential function of this position;

- If you are applying and accepted to a position which requires working in/for the U.S. securities industry, you will be required to provide your fingerprints and undergo additional background checks by the FBI. BNP Paribas Securities Corporation is required to maintain a supervisory program over the conduct of its Associated Persons; some of your personal data will be transmitted to the United States of America and made available to US regulators. Please reach out to BNPP for additional information; or you can also find an overview here: 3110. Supervision FINRA.org

Click here:BNP Paribas in Canada Our job offers

job_description:
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times.



Our employee promise represents Intact’s commitment to you in exchange for living our Values, striving to do your best work, being open to change and investing in your career. In return, we promise to provide support, opportunities and performance-led financial rewards at a workplace where you can shape the future, win as a team and grow with us.



Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented below is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.



Salary Range (but Not Limited To)



52,700 - 65,900



About The Role



Launching your tech career at Intact means joining a diverse team of more than 3,000 Digital, Data and Tech experts working at the intersection of what exists and what’s possible. Here, you’ll be supported by forward-thinking leaders who celebrate shared success, and you’ll help push the industry forward with digital solutions that go beyond insurance to offer everyday value to millions of people. You’ll grow personally and professionally with access to cutting-edge technology-driven learning platforms and make lasting connections near and far. Most importantly, you’ll discover how exciting the “real world” can be.



Here, your career will take off 🚀



We are looking for Data Analyst interns for our growing team!



What you’ll do here: 




- Create and publish dashboards in Adobe Analytics Customer Journey Analytics (CJA).
- Create implementation guides and consolidate data from various sources while ensuring data quality through quality assurance (QA) processes.
- Monitor, identify, and analyze trends; explain anomalies; and provide recommendations regarding results and productivity.
- Build and maintain a data inventory and support the tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Analyze and present information clearly and concisely to various audiences within the organization.
- Create and maintain effective documentation to support training, workflow enhancement, the adoption of best practices, and audit requirements.
- Conceptualize, develop, and implement technical solutions to meet the evolving needs of our partners.
- Collaborate with project team members in developing new reports using Power BI.
- Provide support for other ad hoc needs, including data analyses and implementations.





What you bring to the table: 





- Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in a data-related field, such as AI, computer sciences, marketing, or business, or possess an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Available to work with us full-time, 35 hours per week, for the Winter 2027 Term (January to April).
- Must be an active student during your internship and/or returning to school in next Summer or Fall 2027 following your internship.
- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English speaking colleagues across the country.

- No Canadian work experience required, but must be eligible to work in Canada.

- Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a variety of audiences.
- Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Dynamic, energetic, and proactive.
- At least one internship or prior experience in data analysis is an asset.
- Experience with analytics and tag-management tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools (an asset).
- Knowledge of programming languages such as SQL, JavaScript, and Python (an asset).





Your career starts here.  Apply today! 



We can’t wait to learn more about you. When you complete your application, remember to include your resume and University/College transcript. We hire co-ops every semester (Winter, Summer and Fall)! 



We’re accepting applications now through September 25, 2026.

We are an equal opportunity employer



At Intact, our Value of respect is founded on seeing diversity as a strength. We strive to create an accessible workplace where employees feel valued, included and encouraged to share their unique perspectives.



We encourage applications from individuals who are members of equity-deserving groups, including but not limited to women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, Black people, and members of the 2SLGBTQI+ community.



As part of Intact’s commitment to reconciliation, we acknowledge that we work, meet and travel across the land currently called Canada, originally inhabited by First Nations, Metis and Inuit people. This history extends through many centuries and continues to evolve today.



We have policies to ensure equal access and participation for people with disabilities, including providing workplace adjustments (accommodations). A copy of applicable policies is available on request.



If we can provide a specific adjustment to make the recruitment process more accessible for you, please let us know when we reach out about a job opportunity. We’ll work with you to meet your needs.



Learn more about our recruitment process and your candidate journey here.



Please note that Intact does not provide sponsorship or other support for immigration-related matters including but not limited to employer-specific closed work permits. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada from the anticipated start date and throughout their employment and are solely responsible for maintaining their work eligibility.

Job Description



To be eligible for Pomerleau’s internship program, you must meet the following criteria:




- Be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of application and for the entire duration of the internship.
- Reside in Canada at the time of application and for the entire duration of the internship.
- Be duly enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution or have graduated from such an institution within no more than six (6) months prior to the internship start date.





If you graduated more than six (6) months ago, please refer to our permanent job opportunities.



Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.



Join Pomerleau as a GIS Data Analyst Intern and gain hands-on experience supporting major construction projects across Canada through geospatial data management, GIS standards development, and spatial analysis.



What you will do




- Support the GIS / VDC team in maintaining, structuring, and updating geospatial data related to active construction projects
- Contribute to the development and improvement of GIS standards, data models, naming conventions, and best practices across the organization
- Produce maps, dashboards, and GIS visualizations to support preconstruction, estimation, risk, environmental, and operations teams
- Perform spatial analyses (site constraints, logistics, accessibility, environmental considerations)
- Integrate, transform, and validate data from multiple sources (CAD, Excel, databases, GIS services) using tools such as FME
- Work with spatial and relational databases to ensure data quality, consistency, and traceability
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams and provide GIS support to internal stakeholders





This role could be for you if you have




- Currently enrolled in a college or university program in GIS, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related field
- Basic knowledge of ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online / Enterprise
- Exposure to or interest in FME for data transformation and automation
- Knowledge of databases (spatial or relational), such as geodatabases, SQL-based systems, or cloud data platforms is an asset
- Comfortable working with structured data sets (Excel, tables, spatial layers)
- Interest in the construction and infrastructure industry
- Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a desire to learn and improve standards
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within diverse teams
- French required; functional English is an asset





Benefits





- Hands-on Learning in construction, engineering, sustainability, and tech
- Mentorship from experienced professionals
- Strong Networking with managers, engineers, and executives
- Industry Insight through events, site visits, and team meetings
- Career Growth into roles like project coordinator or site engineer
- Full-Time Potential with high intern-to-employee conversion





For the past six years, we've proudly held the distinction of being one of Canada's Top 100 Employers.



Pomerleau is a national leader in construction, delivering major projects across Canada. We believe in creating a workplace where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and a shared commitment to doing great work. If this speaks to you, apply for this role or connect with one of our recruiters to learn how we can support you throughout the process.

job_description:
Cyient is seeking a motivated and experienced Data Analytics Engineer / Analyst to support an exciting aerospace manufacturing improvement initiative. In this role, you will develop and maintain data solutions, dashboards, and analytical models that enable data-driven decision-making and operational improvement.





If you are passionate about data analytics, enjoy solving complex business problems, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.





Key Responsibilities


- Collaborate with program leads, data analysts, engineers, supply chain, quality, and operations teams to deliver data-driven solutions.
- Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets using Python, SQL, and related technologies.
- Analyze historical performance and demand trends to identify bottlenecks, delivery risks, and critical part numbers.
- Develop data models and KPI dashboards to monitor metrics such as yield, supplier lead times, production performance, and on-time delivery.
- Provide actionable insights to Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations teams to support continuous improvement.
- Support the prioritization of critical components and identification of producibility/process improvement opportunities.
- Use SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, R, and Excel to analyze, visualize, and communicate business insights.
- Support monitoring of corrective actions and their impact on operational and delivery performance.
- Participate in Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA) initiatives.
- Perform data validation and ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
- Support databases, data warehouses, and data lakes.
- Develop and maintain ETL/data transformation processes.
- Assist with data documentation, governance, and technical support.
- Collaborate with senior team members to implement scalable analytics and data solutions.






Required Qualifications


- Eligible to work in Canada and available to work onsite.
- 2–5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related field.
- Aerospace, manufacturing, automotive, defense, or industrial experience is preferred.
- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Statistics, or a related discipline.
- Fluent in French and English, both spoken and written.
- Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.
- Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and Excel.
- Experience with at least one of R or Tableau.
- Knowledge of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent.
- Exposure to Apache Spark and/or Databricks.
- Knowledge of at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Understanding of ETL, data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance.
- Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.






Preferred Qualifications


- Experience in aerospace or manufacturing analytics.
- Experience with Supply Chain, Quality, Production, or Operations data.
- Knowledge of manufacturing KPIs, supplier performance, production yield, lead time, and on-time delivery.
- Exposure to RCCA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, Quality Notifications (QNs), or continuous improvement.
- Experience with producibility analysis or technical feasibility assessments.
- Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools.
- Exposure to Agile methodology.
- Experience with MS Project or project coordination.
- Ability to transform complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it.
DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You'll feel right at home if you:


- Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
- Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
- Are great at finding patterns
- Are great at presenting findings
- Love digging through data in search of clues
- Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
- Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
- Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
- Are extremely organized
- Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
- Have completed a Bachelor's degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
- Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
- Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
- Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
- Ability to work off hours when necessary


What you'll be working on:


- Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
- Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
- Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
- Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
- Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
- Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.

About Velixo



Velixo is an award-winning vendor of Excel-based reporting solutions for Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, such as Acumatica, MYOB, Cegid and Sage Intacct. We serve customers of every size, in every industry, by enhancing their reporting and planning experience, and introducing a world of innovative features and integrations in the Excel they love.



Headquartered in Montreal, Canada, we are a diverse and fast-paced organization that is rapidly growing in revenue and personnel. Our team is spread out across the world to support a growing base strong of 1800+ customers and 200+ value-added resellers worldwide.



About the role:



We are looking for a passionate ERP Data Analyst to join our team at Velixo. As a ERP Data Analyst, you will be responsible for demonstrating product capabilities, analyzing business requirements and designing reporting solutions using SQL and Excel. Your expertise in Microsoft Excel, strong analytical mindset, and ability to provide valuable insights will play a crucial role in helping our customers leverage our Excel-based reporting solution for their ERP systems. This is an exciting opportunity to work in the ERP software industry and be part of a collaborative and growth-oriented team. We are considering candidates anywhere in Canada.



Responsibilities:




- Attend product demonstrations with prospective customers, answer technical questions and demonstrate complex functionalities.

- Create proof-of-concept to highlight Velixo capabilities to prospective customers.

- Gather and analyse customer requirements, identify and solve roadblocks, estimate project scope and write specification documents.

- Develop customer reports based on specification documents.
- Provide initial support to new users, guiding them through the product’s features and troubleshooting common issues.

- Conduct comprehensive training sessions for clients, partners and colleagues to ensure effective use of the product.

- Develop training materials and documentation tailored to different user skill levels.

- Develop a deep understanding of Velixo and the ERP systems that we integrate with. Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends in reporting techniques.






Requirements:




- Bachelor degree in finance, accounting, computer science or engineering.
- 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software industry.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data-enhancement functions, dynamic arrays, filters, conditional formatting, pivot tables, lambdas, and data sources.

- Strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex information to clients.

- Working knowledge of SQL to manipulate and extract data.
- Familiarity with financial reporting and accounting basics.
- Experience working in an ERP system, particularly Acumatica or Sage Intacct, is a plus.






Benefits:




- Competitive benefits package, including health insurance, RRSP plan, vacation and personal days.

- Financial support for professional development courses to enhance skills and knowledge.

- Opportunity for career growth within a collaborative and supportive work environment.






At Velixo, we prioritize the growth and development of our employees, recognizing their potential and providing opportunities to excel in their chosen field. We are excited to welcome you to our team and embark on a journey of mutual success.

Our employee promise represents Intact’s commitment to you in exchange for living our Values, striving to do your best work, being open to change and investing in your career. In return, we promise to provide support, opportunities and performance-led financial rewards at a workplace where you can shape the future, win as a team and grow with us.



Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented below is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.



Salary Range (but Not Limited To)



66,500 - 83,100



About The Role



Launching your tech career at Intact means joining a diverse team of more than 3,000 Digital, Data and Tech experts working at the intersection of what exists and what’s possible. Here, you’ll be supported by forward-thinking leaders who celebrate shared success, and you’ll help push the industry forward with digital solutions that go beyond insurance to offer everyday value to millions of people. You’ll grow personally and professionally with access to cutting-edge technology-driven learning platforms and make lasting connections near and far. Most importantly, you’ll discover how exciting the “real world” can be.



Here, your career will take off 🚀



We are looking for Data Scientist interns for our growing team!



What you’ll do here: 




- Translate complex, multi-source datasets into clear, business-ready insights, recommendations, and measurable impact.
- Build production-quality analytical and ML code (Python/R), using modern libraries and best practices (testing, version control, reproducibility) to deliver robust technical outcomes.
- Contribute to applied research and development that advances AI-enabled products - prototyping, experimenting, and validating approaches that solve real business problems.
- Explore and evaluate cutting-edge methods across the fast-evolving AI landscape (e.g., deep learning, NLP, computer vision, geospatial analytics), and translate promising ideas into practical solutions.
- Work hands-on with diverse data modalities - geomatics/geospatial, telematics/time-series, text, and images - linking patterns in the data to operational and strategic business decisions.
- Communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through concise narratives, visualizations, and well-documented deliverables that support product and business roadmaps.





What You Bring To The Table





- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in a field related to artificial intelligence, data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, or any other related field.
- Available to work with us full-time, 35 hours per week, for the Winter 2027 Term in hybrid mode (January to April).
- Must be an active student during your internship and/or returning to school in next Summer or Fall 2027 following your internship.
- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English speaking colleagues across the country. 
- No Canadian work experience required, but must be eligible to work in Canada.
- At least one previous internship in data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or deep learning is an asset.
- Adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to continuous learning.
- Excellent communication skills with a self-reliant and high-ownership mindset.





Your career starts here.  Apply today! 



We can’t wait to learn more about you. When you complete your application, remember to include your resume and University/College transcript. We hire co-ops every semester (Winter, Summer and Fall)! 



We’re accepting applications now through September 25, 2026.

At Intact, our Value of respect is founded on seeing diversity as a strength. We strive to create an accessible workplace where employees feel valued, included and encouraged to share their unique perspectives.

job_description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.



Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.



McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.



What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.



McKesson est une entreprise du palmarès Fortune 10 guidée par sa volonté d’avoir un impact positif et qui touche pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé. Nous sommes reconnus pour offrir des connaissances, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, nous accordons une grande importance à la santé, au bonheur et au bien-être de nos employés ainsi que des personnes que nous servons, parce que nous avons à cœur ce qui compte le plus.



Chez McKesson, votre travail a un réel impact. Nous favorisons une culture où vous pouvez évoluer, faire une différence et mettre de l’avant de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous prospérons tout en façonnant l’avenir de la santé pour les patients, nos collectivités et nos employés. Si vous souhaitez contribuer dès aujourd’hui aux soins de santé de demain, nous aimerions vous connaître.



Aperçu du programme



Le programme de stages de McKesson est conçu pour offrir :





- Une expérience de travail concrète dans un environnement professionnel
- Une base solide d’expérience
- Une expérience collaborative au sein d’une cohorte de stagiaires
- Des occasions régulières d’apprentissage et d’exposition aux dirigeants de l’entreprise







Nous recherchons des candidats qui possèdent :





- Une volonté d’apprendre, de se développer et de contribuer à un environnement dynamique, stimulant et en évolution rapide
- De l’autonomie, de solides habiletés interpersonnelles ainsi que la capacité de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions
- Une passion pour le domaine de la santé et le succès de nos clients







Période du stage : Du 8 septembre au 31 décembre 2026



Lieu : Saint-Laurent (Québec), 4705 rue Dobrin (hybride)



Résumé du poste



Le ou la stagiaire en communications soutient les activités de communication, de documentation et de mobilisation des parties prenantes pour l’équipe technologique Data Hub Canada. Ce rôle contribue à transformer l’information liée aux données, à la livraison, aux opérations et aux méthodes de travail agiles en communications claires et adaptées aux différents publics, notamment les clients, les partenaires d’affaires et les membres de l’équipe interne.



En collaboration avec l’équipe technologique Data Hub Canada et les partenaires d’affaires, le ou la stagiaire participera à la préparation de mises à jour, de communications de lancement, de documents pour les réunions, d’articles de connaissances et d’autres outils de communication visant à accroître la visibilité, l’harmonisation et l’adoption des services du Data Hub.



Il s’agit d’un rôle d’apprentissage de niveau débutant conçu pour un étudiant ou une étudiante, ou une personne récemment diplômée, désirant acquérir une expérience pratique en communications corporatives, en communications technologiques, en gestion du changement, en transformation numérique et dans les méthodes de travail agiles.



Principales responsabilités





- Participer aux communications destinées aux clients du Data Hub et aux partenaires d’affaires, notamment les mises à jour de statut, les avis de service, les notes de version, le matériel de formation et les communications de suivi.
- Soutenir les activités de communication internes de l’équipe technologique en préparant du matériel clair, concis et conforme à l’image de marque qui explique les initiatives, les priorités, les changements et les résultats du Data Hub.
- Collaborer avec l’équipe technologique Data Hub Canada et les partenaires d’affaires afin de comprendre les exigences liées aux données, le contexte des solutions, l’avancement des livraisons et les besoins en communication.
- Contribuer au maintien d’un flux de communication cohérent entre les activités de livraison, d’exploitation et de soutien, y compris la gestion des demandes, les mises à jour du carnet de produits (backlog), les communications de mise en production, les messages liés aux incidents ou interruptions de service, ainsi que les suivis après déploiement.
- Créer et réviser divers livrables de communication, tels que des infolettres, des publications sur l’intranet, du contenu de présentation, des FAQ, des résumés d’une page, des guides de processus, des mises à jour destinées aux parties prenantes et des annonces d’équipe.
- Appuyer les activités de documentation et de gestion des connaissances en organisant et en améliorant le contenu lié aux processus du Data Hub, aux rôles et responsabilités, au modèle opérationnel, aux pratiques agiles et à la mobilisation des parties prenantes.
- Participer à la planification des communications pour les initiatives du Data Hub, notamment en identifiant les publics cibles, les messages clés, les canaux de communication, les échéanciers et les mécanismes de rétroaction.
- Aider à recueillir, organiser et résumer la rétroaction ainsi que les indicateurs de communication afin d’évaluer la clarté des messages, la compréhension des parties prenantes et l’adoption du matériel de communication.
- Appliquer les normes de McKesson en matière de style, de ton, de confidentialité et de qualité lors de la préparation des communications afin d’assurer un contenu exact, professionnel, inclusif et facile à comprendre.







Qualifications Minimales (connaissances, Compétences Et Aptitudes)





- Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité de vulgariser des informations techniques ou complexes pour différents publics.
- Intérêt marqué pour les communications corporatives, les communications internes, la gestion du changement et les communications technologiques.
- Capacité à collaborer avec des parties prenantes techniques et d’affaires, à poser des questions pertinentes, à cerner les messages clés et à transformer l’information en matériel de communication clair.
- Maîtrise de base des outils Microsoft 365 tels que Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams et SharePoint; une connaissance d’outils de collaboration ou de gestion des connaissances constitue un atout.
- Excellent souci du détail, sens de l’organisation, rigueur dans le suivi et capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches de communication avec encadrement.
- Curiosité et volonté d’en apprendre davantage sur les produits de données, les méthodes de livraison agiles, les opérations de services et le vocabulaire lié à la livraison technologique.
- Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement professionnel, à traiter des renseignements sensibles de façon appropriée et à respecter les processus établis de révision et d’approbation.
- Aisance à participer aux réunions, à documenter les notes ou les décisions et à transformer les résultats des discussions en contenu prêt à communiquer.
- Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est considéré comme un atout.







Expérience professionnelle





- Être actuellement inscrit(e) à un programme d’études postsecondaires, ou l’avoir récemment complété, dans un domaine tel que les communications, les relations publiques, le marketing ou toute discipline connexe.
- Une expérience acquise dans le cadre d’un stage, d’un programme coopératif, d’activités bénévoles, d’un projet académique ou d’un emploi impliquant la rédaction, la révision de contenu, les communications avec des parties prenantes, les présentations, le soutien à des projets ou la création de contenu numérique constitue un atout.
- Une exposition aux équipes technologiques, aux données et analyses, à la gestion du changement ou aux communications d’affaires constitue un atout, sans être obligatoire.
- De 0 à 2 années d’expérience pertinente sont habituellement requises; les projets académiques, stages, expériences coopératives ou autres expériences étudiantes pertinentes sont acceptés.







Indicateurs de réussite et résultats d’apprentissage





- Les communications produites sont claires, concises, exactes, adaptées au public cible et alignées sur les priorités du Data Hub.
- Les parties prenantes bénéficient d’une meilleure visibilité quant aux mises en production, aux mises à jour de livraison, aux changements de service et à l’information de soutien du Data Hub.
- Les documents et outils de communication sont bien organisés, réutilisables et plus faciles à trouver et à utiliser par les équipes et les clients.
- Le ou la stagiaire développe une expérience pratique en communications technologiques, en communications liées aux données et à l’analytique, en livraison agile et en mobilisation des parties prenantes.







Program Overview



McKesson’s Intern program is designed to provide:





- A real-life working environment
- A solid foundation of experience
- A cohort experience with other interns
- Consistent senior leadership exposure and learning experiences.







We are looking for candidates who have:





- Willingness to learn, develop, and contribute to a fun, demanding, fast-paced environment.
- Self-starter that brings both interpersonal skills abilities to identify a problem then solve it.
- Passion and enthusiasm for healthcare and our customers’ success







Work Term: Fall 2026- September 8th through December 31st



Location: Saint-Laurent, QC, CAN - 4705 Dobrin Street (Hybrid)



Job Summary:



The Communication Intern supports communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement activities for the Data Hub Canada technology team. The role helps translate data, delivery, operational, and agile work into clear, audience-appropriate communications for clients, business stakeholders, and internal team members.



Working with Data Hub Canada technology team and business stakeholders, the intern will help prepare updates, release communications, meeting materials, knowledge articles, and other communication assets that improve visibility, alignment, and adoption of Data Hub services.



This is an entry-level learning role designed for a student or recent graduate who wants to gain practical experience in corporate communications, technology communications, change communications, digital transformation, and agile ways of working.



Key Responsibilities:





- Assist with communications to Data Hub clients and business stakeholders, including status updates, service announcements, release notes, training materials, and follow-up messages.
- Support internal communication activities for a technology team by preparing clear, concise, branded materials that explain Data Hub initiatives, priorities, changes, and outcomes.
- Collaborate with Data Hub Canada technology team and business stakeholders to understand data requirements, solution context, delivery progress, and communication needs.
- Help maintain consistent communication flow across delivery, operations, and support activities, including intake, backlog updates, release communication, incident/service disruption messaging, and post-release follow-up.
- Create and edit communication deliverables such as newsletters, intranet posts, slide content, FAQs, one-page summaries, process guides, stakeholder updates, and team announcements.
- Support documentation and knowledge management by organizing and improving content related to Data Hub processes, roles, responsibilities, operating model, agile practices, and stakeholder engagement.
- Assist with communications planning for Data Hub initiatives, including identifying audiences, key messages, communication channels, timing, and feedback mechanisms.
- Help collect, organize, and summarize feedback or communication metrics to evaluate message clarity, stakeholder understanding, and adoption of communication materials.
- Apply McKesson style, tone, confidentiality, and quality expectations when preparing communication materials, ensuring content is accurate, professional, inclusive, and easy to understand.







Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):





- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify technical or complex information for different audiences.
- Interest in corporate communications, internal communications, change communications, technology communications.
- Ability to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, ask thoughtful questions, capture key messages, and translate information into clear communication materials.
- Basic proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools such as Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint; familiarity with collaboration or knowledge management tools is an asset.
- Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple communication tasks with guidance.
- Curiosity and willingness to learn about data products, agile delivery, service operations and technology delivery terminology.
- Ability to work in a professional environment, handle sensitive information appropriately, and follow established review and approval processes.
- Comfort participating in meetings, documenting notes or decisions, and helping convert discussion outcomes into communication-ready content.
- Bilingual (English/French) preferred







Business Experience:





- Currently enrolled in, or recently completed, a post-secondary program in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related field.
- Previous internship, co-op, volunteer, academic project, or work experience involving writing, editing, stakeholder communications, presentations, project support, or digital content is an asset.
- Exposure to technology teams, data and analytics, change management, or business communications is an asset but not required.
- Typically requires 0–2 years of relevant experience; academic projects, internships, co-op placements, or related student experience are acceptable.







Success Indicators / Learning Outcomes:





- Communication materials are clear, concise, accurate, audience-appropriate, and aligned to Data Hub priorities.
- Stakeholders have improved visibility into Data Hub releases, delivery updates, service changes, and support information.
- Documentation and communication assets are organized, reusable, and easier for the team and clients to find and apply.
- The intern builds practical experience in technology communications, data and analytics communications, agile delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

job_description:
BMO Capital Markets



BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service North American-based financial services provider offering equity and debt underwriting, corporate lending and project financing, merger and acquisitions advisory services, securitization, treasury management, market risk management, debt and equity research and institutional sales and trading. BMO Capital Markets has over 2,700 professionals in 30 locations around the world, including 20 offices in North America.



BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US $1.5 trillion total assets and approximately 53,000 employees as of April 30, 2026.



Program Overview:



Co-op Analysts will participate in a one week training and orientation program and are assigned to a specific Investment Banking product or industry group during the program. In addition to this on-the-job experience, the program includes the opportunity to network across various business groups, learn about the culture of BMO Capital Markets, participate in training and learning seminars, and obtain career guidance from dedicated mentors.



Responsibilities:



As an Investment Banking Co-op Analyst at BMO Capital Markets, you will be part of a dynamic investment banking environment, you will gain valuable exposure to a wide number of industries and work with a variety of financial products, including public and private debt and equity financings, mergers and acquisitions, and financial advisory.



Responsibilities can include:




- Running valuation analyses;
- Performing complex financial modeling;
- Conducting industry and company research and analysis;
- Developing client presentations;
- Writing internal and external marketing memoranda;
- Performing other tasks supporting client relationships and business development.







This position is located in Montreal, Quebec and ideally suited to talented, highly motivated individuals who seek to build a solid, comprehensive foundation in the basic skills of investment banking. Candidates must be fluent-bilingual in French and English.

Qualifications:





As an Analyst you will be part of a dynamic investment banking environment. We are looking for highly motivated, mature individuals with:




- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program; graduating in 2028, 2029, 2030
- Proven track record of excellent academic standing, extra curricular participation and demonstrated interest in finance
- Outstanding academic, achievement and peer recognition
- Excellent analytical skills in business, financial and credit analysis areas
- Strong interpersonal skills used within a demanding team environment
- Ability to attentively review, assess and provide detailed information daily on multiple projects in an organized manner
- Excellent capacity to independently function as part of a team through self-motivation
- Strong work ethic
- A high level of integrity
- Preference will be given to students in finance, accounting, economics, engineering and math (statistics)
- Fluent Bilingual in French and English

The intern also supports the Business Partner team for initiatives through communications operations, campaign coordination, metrics reporting, and visual asset preparation.



The ideal candidate can learn and develop organizational and communication skills with technical proficiency, digital platform expertise, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced corporate environment.

The co-op program was designed to help students improve their skills and explore their professional interests through hands-on experience and professional guidance, while also helping them develop core competencies. As an intern, you have access to:




- Professional development sessions

- Mentorship from leaders and colleagues aimed at setting and achieving your career goals

Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $18-32/hour. This role is an existing vacancy.

Internal communications publishing & distribution


- Coordinate the publication and distribution of global internal communications through enterprise communication platforms, including Poppulo, SharePoint Online/Intranet, and Viva Engage.
- Build and distribute bilingual global email communications using branded templates and enterprise communication standards.
- Prepare and publish internal news articles, announcements, and campaign content for enterprise audiences.
- Support bilingual communication workflows and coordinate translation requests for English and French communications.




Executive & enterprise communications support


- Support executive communications initiatives through the creation of Outlook email templates and communication assets.
- Assist with the preparation and formatting of executive presentations and communication materials.
- Support urgent internal communications requests and time-sensitive executive deliverables.




Communications operations & campaign coordination


- Maintain and update internal communications campaign calendars and content schedules.
- Coordinate timelines, approvals, and follow-ups with internal stakeholders and Business Partners.
- Ensure campaign information and communications activities remain accurate and up to date across internal tracking systems.
- Support internal communications governance and process documentation initiatives.




Reporting & analytics


- Produce monthly communications performance reports and engagement metrics.
- Analyze internal communications performance across channels including:


o Poppulo

o Global News/Intranet articles

o Viva Engage

o Google Analytics dashboards


- Support campaign reporting and post-mortem activities for major enterprise initiatives.




Visual communications & presentation support


- Prepare branded communication assets using approved corporate templates.
- Design and edit PowerPoint presentations to ensure clarity, accessibility, and alignment with brand standards.
- Support the creation of visual communication materials for communication plans, comms packs, and enterprise campaigns.




Digital platform & technical support


- Support SharePoint site maintenance, migration activities, permissions coordination, and content organization.
- Contribute to process improvements, workflow optimization, and AI-enabled knowledge resources for the communications team.




Required qualifications to be successful in this role

Education & experience


- Currently enrolled in postsecondary education in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.




Technical skills


- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:


o PowerPoint

o Excel

o Outlook

o Teams


- Experience with enterprise communication and publishing platforms such as:


o Poppulo

o SharePoint Online

o Viva Engage

o Divvy HQ


- Experience with AI tools such as:


o Chat GPT

o Microsoft CoPilot



Soft skills & competencies


- Strong organizational and time management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and urgent requests in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
- Ability to work collaboratively across teams and stakeholder groups.
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.

job_description:
Cyient is seeking a motivated and experienced Data Analytics Engineer / Analyst to support an exciting aerospace manufacturing improvement initiative. In this role, you will develop and maintain data solutions, dashboards, and analytical models that enable data-driven decision-making and operational improvement.





If you are passionate about data analytics, enjoy solving complex business problems, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.





Key Responsibilities


- Collaborate with program leads, data analysts, engineers, supply chain, quality, and operations teams to deliver data-driven solutions.
- Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets using Python, SQL, and related technologies.
- Analyze historical performance and demand trends to identify bottlenecks, delivery risks, and critical part numbers.
- Develop data models and KPI dashboards to monitor metrics such as yield, supplier lead times, production performance, and on-time delivery.
- Provide actionable insights to Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations teams to support continuous improvement.
- Support the prioritization of critical components and identification of producibility/process improvement opportunities.
- Use SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, R, and Excel to analyze, visualize, and communicate business insights.
- Support monitoring of corrective actions and their impact on operational and delivery performance.
- Participate in Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA) initiatives.
- Perform data validation and ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency.
- Support databases, data warehouses, and data lakes.
- Develop and maintain ETL/data transformation processes.
- Assist with data documentation, governance, and technical support.
- Collaborate with senior team members to implement scalable analytics and data solutions.






Required Qualifications


- Eligible to work in Canada and available to work onsite.
- 2–5 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related field.
- Aerospace, manufacturing, automotive, defense, or industrial experience is preferred.
- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Statistics, or a related discipline.
- Fluent in French and English, both spoken and written.
- Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.
- Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and Excel.
- Experience with at least one of R or Tableau.
- Knowledge of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent.
- Exposure to Apache Spark and/or Databricks.
- Knowledge of at least one cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Understanding of ETL, data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance.
- Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.






Preferred Qualifications


- Experience in aerospace or manufacturing analytics.
- Experience with Supply Chain, Quality, Production, or Operations data.
- Knowledge of manufacturing KPIs, supplier performance, production yield, lead time, and on-time delivery.
- Exposure to RCCA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, Quality Notifications (QNs), or continuous improvement.
- Experience with producibility analysis or technical feasibility assessments.
- Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools.
- Exposure to Agile methodology.
- Experience with MS Project or project coordination.
- Ability to transform complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.

However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.



Salary Range (but Not Limited To)



52,700 - 65,900



About The Role



Launching your tech career at Intact means joining a diverse team of more than 3,000 Digital, Data and Tech experts working at the intersection of what exists and what’s possible. Here, you’ll be supported by forward-thinking leaders who celebrate shared success, and you’ll help push the industry forward with digital solutions that go beyond insurance to offer everyday value to millions of people. You’ll grow personally and professionally with access to cutting-edge technology-driven learning platforms and make lasting connections near and far. Most importantly, you’ll discover how exciting the “real world” can be.



Here, your career will take off 🚀



We are looking for Data Analyst interns for our growing team!



What you’ll do here: 




- Create and publish dashboards in Adobe Analytics Customer Journey Analytics (CJA).
- Create implementation guides and consolidate data from various sources while ensuring data quality through quality assurance (QA) processes.
- Monitor, identify, and analyze trends; explain anomalies; and provide recommendations regarding results and productivity.
- Build and maintain a data inventory and support the tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Analyze and present information clearly and concisely to various audiences within the organization.
- Create and maintain effective documentation to support training, workflow enhancement, the adoption of best practices, and audit requirements.
- Conceptualize, develop, and implement technical solutions to meet the evolving needs of our partners.
- Collaborate with project team members in developing new reports using Power BI.
- Provide support for other ad hoc needs, including data analyses and implementations.





What you bring to the table: 





- Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in a data-related field, such as AI, computer sciences, marketing, or business, or possess an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Available to work with us full-time, 35 hours per week, for the Winter 2027 Term (January to April).
- Must be an active student during your internship and/or returning to school in next Summer or Fall 2027 following your internship.
- For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English speaking colleagues across the country.

- No Canadian work experience required, but must be eligible to work in Canada.

- Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a variety of audiences.
- Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Dynamic, energetic, and proactive.
- At least one internship or prior experience in data analysis is an asset.
- Experience with analytics and tag-management tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools (an asset).
- Knowledge of programming languages such as SQL, JavaScript, and Python (an asset).





Your career starts here.  Apply today! 



We can’t wait to learn more about you. When you complete your application, remember to include your resume and University/College transcript. We hire co-ops every semester (Winter, Summer and Fall)! 



We’re accepting applications now through September 25, 2026.

- Impact

accessibility@dialogue.co.

To ensure an efficient and fair review process, we utilize artificial intelligence tools to assist in the initial screening and assessment of applicants for this role.

Dialogue only contacts candidates through official 
@dialogue.co email addresses. We never request payment, gift cards, or personal financial information at any stage of hiring, and we never extend an offer without a structured interview process. All open roles are listed exclusively at dialogue.co/en/careers. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to be from Dialogue, do not respond — report it to
jobs@dialogue.co and verify the role on our official careers page.



Your role as Product Data Analyst



Dialogue is looking for a Product Data Analyst to take part in our mission to help people improve their wellbeing. Working closely with Vanessa Jones, Director of Product, your role will be to serve as the engine for product decisions, turning complex data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, drive alignment and measure product performance.



Want to join our exceptional multidisciplinary team in an evolving industry? Good news, we saved you a seat!



What You'll Be Doing





- Drive Product Strategy: Partner closely with the Product team to explore problem areas, uncover behavioral trends, and use data to influence our product roadmap.

- Build Data Infrastructure: Collaborate with development teams to design, integrate, and maintain robust analytics tracking, telemetry, and event pipelines across our platforms. As a member of Dialogue's Data Guild, propose and validate data models using data platform tools, and contribute to shared data standards across teams.
- Leverage AI Workflows: Integrate modern AI tools into your daily analysis—focusing your time on problem definition, stakeholder alignment, and insight translation rather than manual tasks.





We'd love to hear from you if you have

À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.





Ce que nous offrons


- ** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
- Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
- Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
- Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
- Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
- Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
- 3 semaines de vacances par année.
- 5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
- Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
- Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
- Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
- La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.






Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.





Responsabilités


- Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
- Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
- Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
- Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
- Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
- Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.






Exigences


- D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
- 2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
- Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
- Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
- Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
- Bilinguisme français et anglais.
- Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.






La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.





--





About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.





What We Offer


- ** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
- 100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
- Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
- Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
- Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
- A MacBook computer on your first day.
- 3 weeks vacation.
- 5 personal days to use at your discretion.
- A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
- The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
- A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.






About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.





Key Responsibilities


- Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
- Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
- Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
- Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
- Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
- Special projects, and other duties as required.






Candidate Qualifications


- Strong problem solving skills.
- 2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
- Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
- Understanding of statistical principles.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Fully bilingual in English and French.
- Ability to coordinate across teams.






Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

 At Confluence, we've always been driven by a commitment to innovation, precision, and partnership in the investment data space. job_description:
Data Security & DLP Analyst (AI Training)



About The Role



At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build and train frontier AI models. We're looking for data security professionals who understand how real data leaks happen — and can bring that knowledge to one of the most consequential technology challenges of our time.



Your expertise in DLP controls, data classification, and security operations will directly shape how AI systems reason about sensitive information, exposure risk, and data protection. This is a rare opportunity to apply deep security knowledge in a cutting-edge AI context — on your own schedule, from anywhere.




- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week





What You'll Do





- Analyze realistic data security and DLP scenarios across cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments
- Classify data sensitivity levels, exposure paths, and policy violations with precision
- Evaluate prevention, detection, and incident response strategies for real-world applicability
- Generate, label, and validate data security cases used to train and benchmark AI systems
- Help AI models develop accurate, nuanced understanding of how sensitive information risk plays out in modern organizations





Who You Are





- 2+ years of experience in data security, compliance, security operations, or a related field
- Solid familiarity with DLP tools, data classification frameworks, and privacy or regulatory concepts (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA)
- Practical, hands-on understanding of how data risk manifests in real enterprise environments
- Strong analytical thinking and ability to communicate complex scenarios in structured, clear formats
- Self-motivated and comfortable working independently on task-based assignments





Nice to Have





- Experience with cloud security platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or SaaS security controls
- Background in security engineering, GRC, or insider threat programs
- Familiarity with AI workflows or data annotation projects





Why Join Us





- Work directly on frontier AI systems built with top research labs
- Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work at your own pace
- Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
- Put your real-world security expertise to work on problems that matter
- Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Mener des analyses proactives pour identifier des informations exploitables, notamment en se plongeant dans l'entonnoir du produit de base, les cohortes d'utilisateurs et en analysant les données relatives au comportement des utilisateurs, afin d'identifier les domaines de l'expérience utilisateur qui peuvent être améliorés pour générer de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.

Définir des ICP pour l'entreprise et construire des tableaux de bord automatisés, des rapports et des modèles pour permettre aux équipes de Mistplay de prendre de meilleures décisions.

Concevoir, coordonner et analyser les résultats d'expériences multivariées sur les produits afin de stimuler la croissance, d'améliorer les caractéristiques des produits existants et de tester de nouveaux domaines d'opportunités.






-

Collaborer avec les parties prenantes des données, du produit, du marketing et de l'ingénierie pour définir les problèmes commerciaux, les projets, identifier les risques et les dépendances, et créer des plans d'exécution.











Ce que tu apporteras à Mistplay :




-

BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.






-

4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.






-

Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des concepts et des analyses complexes de manière simple et facile à comprendre, à un large éventail de publics techniques et non techniques.

Expérience des tests A/B et solides connaissances de base des concepts de statistiques inférentielles (signification, puissance, intervalles de confiance, variance, etc.)






-

Maîtrise du langage SQL. Expérience de l'extraction de données complexes et hautement dimensionnelles, ainsi que de la modélisation de scénarios et de l'analyse de sensibilité à l'aide d'Excel.






-

Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique






-

Familiarité avec Tableau ou tout autre outil de BI






-

Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports.






-

Une attitude positive et une bonne dose de curiosité naturelle. Il faut répondre aux questions et nos données ne vont pas s'analyser toutes seules. (Nous y travaillons.)

Une passion pour les jeux et une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu.

The Senior Data Analyst I within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.

-

Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling

Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool

Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports

Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)











Bonus if you have:




-

A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry

Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques






-

Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

The Data Analyst, Medical Insights (Senior Manager) is accountable for delivering ad hoc and exploratory analysis that answers business and scientific questions the platform can't natively address, working globally across regions and the Medical Insights team. This role partners closely with the Insights Platform Lead, surfacing where recurring analytical requests reveal gaps the platform should be built to close.
