job_description:
Not the Flashiest Title in the Building. Possibly the 
Most Important.






Data Analyst · Encore Travel · Hybrid, Montréal



No mission statement ever says "accurate data," yet every great decision depends on it.



What Encore is turning into






Encore is becoming the intelligence company that scales care.






We want technology to make the relationships we build and maintain stronger, not thinner. That takes data. A lot of it. Our team's job is to make that data ready, reliable, and available, and to connect the machine model of our company.






This is bigger than reporting. The same reliable data is what lets an account manager, or an AI system working alongside them, actually know a customer well enough to help them like a person, not a record in a system. That's how you scale care instead of just scaling volume.



What you'll actually be doing






You're energized when you get to hand someone the answer to a problem they've been stuck on. You know how to take something theoretical, break down the terms, ask the right questions, and come up with answers. Your mandate is to become the go-to expert who knows exactly which combination of queries, charts, and KPIs turns into an actual, meaningful conversation.






Being the goalie for the business's insights. You won't produce every report yourself, but you're accountable for the ones that matter. Our colleagues rely on you for timely, accurate reporting on our customers, our tools, operations, and finances, and for making sense of the data when it isn't obvious.






Safeguarding trust in our systems is the gold standard, and that starts with the relationships we build across the business, relationships that increasingly include AI. Your validation tooling, semantic definitions, canonical queries, and reporting artifacts serve both.







Requirements


Your actual superpower






Your superpower is mixing customer service communication with detail-oriented output. You can sit with someone who's stuck, listen well, and know exactly what needs pulling and why. Then you build it, carefully, and it holds up.



The team you're joining






You'll report to our Director, Intelligence and Standards, and work alongside our Intelligence Designer.



This is you if





- 


You're early in your career. Recent grad, or somewhere in your first 3 years.







- 


You're drawn to what data means for the business and the customer journey, more than the engineering underneath it. You'd pitch yourself for finance or product before engineering.







- 


You have core competencies in SQL and Python.







- 


You care as much about explaining something clearly as about getting it right.








What you'll walk away knowing






Our business. Our customers. Our models. Every signal our teams use to make the calls that matter. First, you'll accelerate what our experts already know, making their intuitions tangible, visual, and ready for internal and external review. Then you'll get people who never thought to ask a question to start asking it. Together, the goal is data that's available, clear, trustworthy, and understandable, so that no decision gets made without it again.



How to apply






Skip the cover letter. Show us a time you took a pile of confusing data and made it click for someone, a dashboard, a report, a spreadsheet you're weirdly proud of, an analysis that changed someone's mind. Tell us what it was and what you'd do differently now.







Send it to elizabeth.oxton@encoretravel.com. We reply to everyone, within a week.

Montreal, Canada -Hybrid



Why Confluence?



At Confluence, we’ve always been driven by a commitment to innovation, precision, and partnership in the investment data space. This is a high-impact role within a lean team, sitting at the intersection of product, data, and engineering.

- Translate business and product requirements into clear technical data specifications for engineering teams

- Own small to mid-sized data projects end-to-end, balancing multiple requests and priorities
- Identify opportunities to automate and optimize processes using Python or similar tools
- Partner with stakeholders across product, engineering, and BI teams to ensure data solutions meet business needs



Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas or consider candidates requiring work permits at this time.





What skills and experience do I need to succeed?



What You Bring



Essential Requirements



- Strong SQL expertise (non-negotiable)
- Ability to work effectively with data pipelines, schemas, feeds, APIs, and data warehouses
- Proven ability to work independently with data and deliver solutions end-to-end
- Experience translating business requirements into clear technical specifications
- Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage multiple requests or projects simultaneously
- 1–3 years’ experience in a market data, data analytics, or financial data environment


Nice to Have



- Python for automation or process improvement
- Experience with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake)
- Familiarity with data ingestion, transformation, and vendor data workflows

- Exposure to AI tools or an interest in automation

Confluence offers generous benefit packages for team members. As a growing, global organization, we are always looking for ways to ensure that our employees can access benefits that matter to them and their families. This includes:

Values

Naboo is the AI-powered event procurement platform that helps companies plan and book corporate offsites, team retreats, and business events, all in one place.

After raising a $70M Series B led by Lightspeed, we're now expanding aggressively into North America, and Montreal is our launchpad.

The Job

This is a hands-on, high-volume outbound sales internship based full-time in our Montreal office.

You will work directly under the Head of Enterprise Sales, who is based in New York City, owning real targets from day one — prospecting into US enterprise accounts, making 100+ cold calls daily, and booking qualified meetings with Procurement and M&E decision-makers across the American market. - Make 100+ outbound cold calls per day to US-based enterprise prospects

- Qualify leads and set meetings with Procurement and Meetings & Events stakeholders
- Learn Naboo's value proposition and how to position it against the market
- Contribute directly to pipeline generation for the North America region


You Are


- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program
- Based in Montreal and available to work in-office five days a week (from August to December)

- Direct mentorship: Report directly to and learn from the Head of Enterprise Sales — no fluff, real reps

What We Offer

- Exécuter avec précision et dans les délais des transactions et des dérogations plus complexes conformément aux lignes directrices et procédures établies, tout en respectant les ententes de niveau de service (SLA) applicables.
- Déterminer, documenter et examiner les exceptions ou écarts liés aux transactions et aux processus qui dépassent le niveau de service opérationnel de première ligne.
- Collaborer avec les partenaires sur des initiatives clés et, au besoin, agir comme responsable de projet ou expert-conseil pour de petites initiatives en respectant les méthodologies de gestion de projet.
- Signaler ou faire remonter les problèmes de traitement ou d’exploitation au besoin en s’appuyant sur une bonne compréhension des enjeux et en mobilisant les partenaires appropriés afin de faciliter leur résolution et de maintenir la qualité du service.
- Déterminer des occasions d’améliorer la prestation de services.
- Fournir une analyse exacte et approfondie des principaux facteurs de processus ainsi que des causes fondamentales ou systémiques des enjeux opérationnels interfonctionnels, interpréter les résultats et formuler des recommandations.
- Soutenir les partenaires en traitant les demandes entrantes et sortantes provenant de divers canaux, répondre aux questions et effectuer les ajustements autorisés.
- Contribuer à la production de rapports consolidés ou agrégés, selon les besoins.
- Maintenir de bonnes relations avec la clientèle en résolvant les problèmes et en expliquant les processus d’affaires afin de répondre aux demandes.
- Interagir, au besoin, avec d’autres partenaires ou fournisseurs, leur fournir des conseils ou répondre à leurs questions et préoccupations de façon efficace et en temps opportun.





Actionnaires




- Établir les priorités et gérer sa charge de travail afin de respecter les exigences de service et de productivité prévues dans les SLA.
- Maintenir une bonne compréhension des réglementations internes et du secteur, surveiller les tendances, partager ses connaissances concernant les nouveaux enjeux et risques, et évaluer les répercussions possibles sur les politiques, normes et procédures opérationnelles.
- Faire preuve de discernement dans la gestion de la correspondance, de l’information et de tous les dossiers confidentiels.
- Analyser les problèmes de prestation de services, réaliser des recherches internes ou externes, contribuer aux examens d’audit, effectuer des tests et produire des rapports afin de proposer des solutions conformes à l’appétit pour le risque de TD tout en améliorant l’expérience client et en soutenant les objectifs d’affaires.
- Participer à l’élaboration ou à la mise en œuvre de normes, politiques, procédures et solutions visant à atténuer les risques et à maximiser l’accessibilité, l’efficacité et la qualité du service.
- Contribuer à la préparation et à la présentation de communications destinées à la direction ou à un public plus large.
- Protéger les intérêts de l’organisation en déterminant et en gérant les risques et en veillant à la résolution rapide et complète des situations exceptionnelles à risque élevé.
- Respecter les cadres et méthodologies de l’entreprise liés aux activités opérationnelles de son secteur (par exemple, la lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et la gestion de la continuité des activités).
- Soutenir les projets ou programmes de gestion du changement ayant une incidence sur les activités, les fonctions ou les processus, et veiller à une documentation et une communication claires des nouveaux processus.





Employé(e)/Équipe




- Participer pleinement en tant que membre de l’équipe et contribuer à un environnement de travail positif favorisant le service à l’entreprise, la qualité, l’innovation et le travail d’équipe, tout en communiquant rapidement les enjeux pertinents.
- Soutenir l’équipe en développant continuellement ses connaissances opérationnelles, en analysant de façon critique les processus et les possibilités d’amélioration, en partageant des idées et des connaissances au sein de l’équipe, de la fonction et avec les partenaires.
- Offrir de la formation, du mentorat ou du soutien à d’autres membres de l’équipe.
- Participer à la gestion du rendement et à son propre développement professionnel, notamment par la formation croisée au sein de son équipe et d’autres équipes opérationnelles.
- Assurer une communication rapide des enjeux importants pour l’équipe et favoriser de bonnes relations de travail avec les autres services.
- Tenir les parties concernées informées de l’état d’avancement des projets ainsi que de toute information pertinente liée aux activités quotidiennes.
- Contribuer à la réussite de l’équipe en aidant volontairement les autres à accomplir leurs tâches et en fournissant au besoin de la formation, du mentorat ou des conseils.
- Contribuer à un environnement de travail équitable, positif et inclusif qui favorise la diversité.
- Agir à titre d’ambassadeur ou d’ambassadrice de la fonction et de la Banque, tant à l’interne qu’à l’externe.





Portée et complexité du poste




- Travaille dans un environnement comportant des paramètres larges ou non standard, impliquant plusieurs étapes, systèmes et territoires, où les pratiques du marché peuvent être peu définies, avec recours à un niveau supérieur au besoin.
- Responsable de résoudre les exceptions et situations non standard ou d’effectuer les escalades appropriées lorsque les politiques ou règles nécessitent davantage de clarté ou d’interprétation.
- Les transactions sont associées à un faible ou moyen niveau de risque ou d’incidence financière.
- Pouvoir décisionnel limité à modéré dans un cadre défini.
- Fournit des conseils relatifs aux processus et aux politiques à des partenaires internes et à des clients externes.
- Peut agir comme principal coordonnateur de petites initiatives ou de mandats spécifiques.
- Le travail porte sur des activités quotidiennes, hebdomadaires, mensuelles ou à plus long terme, ainsi que sur des demandes ponctuelles et des projets spéciaux.
- Exige une connaissance avancée de l’unité d’affaires, des fonctions opérationnelles et des exigences réglementaires applicables.
- Peut collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des partenaires externes.
- Relève généralement d’un gestionnaire d’équipe.





EXIGENCES DU POSTE



Nous sommes fiers de travailler avec des collègues aux parcours diversifiés. Si vous possédez une expérience pertinente qui n’est pas mentionnée ci-dessous, nous vous invitons à la mettre en valeur dans votre CV ou votre lettre de présentation.




- Être actuellement inscrit(e) à un programme universitaire de premier cycle en administration des affaires, commerce ou dans un domaine connexe.
- Devoir retourner aux études à la fin du stage (condition obligatoire pour tous les postes de stage coopératif ou de stage étudiant).
- Être une personne polyvalente qui travaille efficacement de façon autonome comme en équipe.
- Démontrer un fort désir d’apprendre, de se développer et de réussir.





RENSEIGNEMENTS SUPPLÉMENTAIRES




- Il s’agit d’un stage de 4 mois, du 4 janvier au 23 avril 2027.
- Les candidatures doivent comprendre un relevé de notes, une lettre de présentation (maximum d’une page) et un CV (maximum de deux pages).
- Nous remercions toutes les personnes qui soumettent leur candidature; toutefois, seules les personnes retenues pour une entrevue seront contactées.
- TD exige que les employés résident dans le pays où le poste est situé, peu importe les modalités de télétravail.
- Afin d’offrir la meilleure expérience possible aux candidats et aux stagiaires, l’emplacement du poste et la date d’entrée en fonction peuvent être modifiés.





Nous sommes ravis que vous envisagiez de faire carrière à la TD. Grâce à des conversations régulières sur le perfectionnement professionnel, à des programmes de formation et à un régime d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel, nous nous engageons à offrir à nos collègues le soutien dont ils ont besoin pour s’épanouir tant au travail qu’à la maison.



Développement des collègues



Si vous souhaitez suivre un parcours professionnel particulier ou développer certaines compétences, nous voulons vous aider à réussir. Vous aurez régulièrement des discussions avec votre gestionnaire concernant votre carrière, votre développement et votre rendement. Vous aurez également accès à une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne et à divers programmes de mentorat visant à favoriser votre progression professionnelle.



Que vous soyez passionné(e) par le service à la clientèle et souhaitiez approfondir votre expertise ou que vous souhaitiez encadrer et inspirer vos collègues, de nombreuses possibilités de carrière s’offrent à vous chez TD. Nous nous engageons à vous aider à trouver celles qui correspondent le mieux à vos objectifs.



Formation et intégration



Nous vous offrirons une formation et un programme d’intégration en personne afin de vous fournir tous les outils nécessaires à votre réussite dans votre nouveau rôle.



Processus d’entrevue



Nous communiquerons avec les candidats retenus afin de planifier une entrevue. Nous faisons tout notre possible pour informer l’ensemble des candidats des résultats par courriel ou par téléphone.



HORAIRE



Du lundi au vendredi, pendant les heures normales de bureau.



INCLUSION



À la TD, nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et accessible où tous les employés et clients se sentent valorisés, respectés et soutenus. Nous nous consacrons à bâtir un effectif qui reflète la diversité de notre clientèle et des collectivités que nous servons.



Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation dans le cadre du processus de recrutement ou d’entrevue (y compris des documents dans un format alternatif, des salles de rencontre accessibles ou toute autre mesure d’adaptation), veuillez nous en informer. Nous travaillerons avec vous afin de répondre à vos besoins.



À propos de nous



La TD est un chef de file mondial dans le secteur des institutions financières. Elle est la cinquième banque en importance en Amérique du Nord de par son nombre de succursales. Chaque jour, nous nous efforçons de rendre chaque interaction, chaque produit et chaque expérience remarquablement humaine et agréablement simple à plus de 27 millions de ménages et d’entreprises au Canada, aux États-Unis et partout dans le monde. Plus de 95 000 collègues de la TD mettent à profit leurs compétences, leur talent et leur créativité pour approfondir les relations, assurer une exécution rigoureuse et rendre l’expérience bancaire plus simple et plus rapide. La TD est une entreprise profondément engagée à être une leader en matière d’expérience client. Voilà pourquoi nous croyons que chaque collègue, peu importe son secteur d’activité, est en contact avec la clientèle. Ensemble, nous réimaginons l’expérience bancaire et ses possibilités pour notre clientèle, nos collègues et nos collectivités.



Notre programme de rémunération globale



Notre programme de rémunération globale reflète les investissements que nous faisons pour aider nos collègues et leur famille à atteindre leurs objectifs en matière de bien-être mental, physique et financier. La rémunération globale à la TD inclut le salaire de base, la rémunération variable et bien d’autres régimes clés, comme des avantages sociaux en matière de santé et de bien-être, des régimes d’épargne et de retraite, des congés payés, des avantages bancaires et des rabais, des occasions de développement de carrière et des programmes de récompenses et reconnaissance. En savoir plus



Renseignements Supplémentaires



Nous sommes ravis que vous envisagiez une carrière à la TD. Sachez que nous avons à cœur d’aider nos collègues à réussir dans leur vie tant personnelle que professionnelle. C’est d’ailleurs pourquoi nous leur offrons des conversations sur le perfectionnement, des programmes de formation et un régime d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel.



Perfectionnement des collègues



Un cheminement professionnel précis vous intéresse ou bien vous cherchez à perfectionner certaines compétences? Nous tenons à vous mettre sur la voie de la réussite. Vous aurez des conversations régulières sur le développement de carrière, le perfectionnement et le rendement avec votre gestionnaire. Si vous avez à cœur d’aider vos clients et de nouer des relations solides et durables, la TD offre divers parcours de carrière où vous pouvez accroître votre expertise et avoir une incidence significative.



Nous sommes déterminés à appuyer votre réussite et à favoriser un milieu de travail respectueux où la diversité des points de vue est valorisée, où chacun a les mêmes occasions de progresser et où vous pouvez vous réaliser pleinement et atteindre vos objectifs de carrière. À la TD, nous attirons et perfectionnons les meilleurs talents.



Formation et intégration



Nous tenons à nous assurer que vous disposez des outils et ressources nécessaires pour réussir à votre nouveau poste. Dans cette optique, nous organiserons des séances d’intégration et de formation.



Processus d’entrevue



Nous communiquerons avec les candidats sélectionnés pour planifier une entrevue. Nous ferons notre possible pour communiquer par courriel ou par téléphone avec tous les candidats pour leur faire part de notre décision.



Mesures d’adaptation



L’accessibilité est importante pour nous. N’hésitez pas à nous faire part de toute mesure d’adaptation (salles de réunion accessibles, sous-titres pour les entrevues virtuelles, etc.) dont vous pourriez avoir besoin pour participer sans entraves au processus d’entrevue.



Nous avons hâte d’avoir de vos nouvelles!



Exigences Linguistiques (Québec Seulement)

job_description:
Requisition ID: 273037



Employee Referral Program – Potential Reward



We are committed to investing in our employees and helping you continue your career at Scotiabank.



Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.



Location: Montréal, QC



Term: January - August 2027



Work Hours: 37.5 Hours per week



Application Deadline: 10/05/2026



Kickstart your career with Scotiabank’s Commercial Aspire Program! This is your opportunity to gain real-world experience, build your network, and explore what it’s like to work in Canadian Commercial Banking—all while contributing meaningfully to our teams. Aspire is designed for ambitious students who are curious, collaborative, and eager to learn. We're looking for students who demonstrate strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity, accountability, and a desire to make a meaningful contribution.



If you want to strengthen your credit, financial analysis, and business acumen, this opportunity will provide hands-on exposure to a team that supports mid-sized businesses across a variety of industries. You'll gain experience analyzing businesses, assessing credit risk, supporting financing decisions, and building relationships with clients while developing a strong understanding of Commercial Banking.



The Mid-Market team offers tailored financial advice and solutions to a broad spectrum of mid-sized businesses across Canada, spanning various industries such as manufacturing, retail, technology, and professional services. We collaborate closely with clients to understand their operational needs, growth ambitions, and unique challenges, delivering customized lending, treasury, and banking services to support their development at every stage. This role provides exposure to dynamic financial transactions, specialized credit analysis, and the opportunity to build comprehensive expertise within one of our key growth segments.



Is this role right for you?



With Aspire, You’ll Gain Early Exposure To Commercial Banking By Working On Meaningful Projects And Learning From Experienced Professionals. You’ll Have Opportunities To




- Support client relationship teams with research, financial analysis, and administrative tasks.
- Conduct company and industry analysis to inform credit and business decisions.
- Build your analytical and communication skills in a structured, collaborative environment.
- Learn how the Bank balances client needs with risk and operational considerations.
- Contribute to delivering timely, high-quality support on key projects.
- Partner across teams to help drive business outcomes and process improvements.
- Champion a client-focused culture to build and deepen relationships with clients and internal partners, leveraging the Bank’s broader relationships, systems, and knowledge.
- Ensure that the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture are considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.





Who We’re Looking For



You thrive in a structured environment with clear guidance and deadlines, and you bring a
positive, flexible, and professional attitude.



Key Capabilities





- You are client-centric and passionate about enhancing the client experience
- You are collaborative and work effectively with others
- You are organized and able to manage multiple priorities with strong attention to detail
- You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
- You are analytical and use data to inform decisions and recommendations
- You are adept at identifying problems and developing effective, strategic solutions





Key Requirements





- You are enrolled in an undergraduate degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
- You have strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills
- You have good presentation skills and consistently demonstrate professionalism
- You have a natural curiosity and eagerness to learn about Commercial Banking

We focus on relationships over resumes. Instead of submitting a traditional resume, please:




- Complete your PLUM Profile and save a screenshot.
- Complete a short one-way video interview here.
- Apply to the role and upload your PLUM Profile screenshot when prompted for a resume.

Job Description:


DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW



Co-op and Internship opportunities allow you to gain valuable work experience across a number of the businesses at TD. You will work with experienced colleagues, receive world class training, and be part of a community of students across TD, where you will have an impact, grow as individual and experience our culture of care.

- Leadership talks with key Leaders from across the organization
- Lunch and Learns on topics such as Innovation
- Diversity and Inclusion and Personal Branding and so much more




JOB DESCRIPTION



Customer:


- Execute more complex transactions and overrides accurately, on time and in line with established guidelines/procedures while adhering to formal or informal Service Level Agreement(s) (SLAs)
- Identify, document, and investigate processes/exceptions arising from transactions/processes beyond first level operations service delivery
- Coordinate with partners on key initiatives and may act as a project lead/subject matter expert for small-scale projects/initiatives in accordance with project management methodologies
- Refer or escalate processing or operational issues as needed based on a solid understanding of the issue, connecting with the appropriate function/partner to facilitate resolution and ensure that service quality is maintained
- Identify opportunities to improve service delivery
- Provide accurate and thorough analysis of key process drivers, root or systemic causes of cross functional operational issues, interpret findings and make recommendations
- Support partners with both inbound and outbound requests from various channels, answering questions to perform adjustments within authority levels
- Contribute to the production of consolidated or aggregated reporting as appropriate
- Maintain working relationships with customers by resolving customer issues and articulating business processes to respond to customer queries
- May interact with other partners and vendors, providing guidance and/or addressing questions/concerns in an effective and timely manner




Shareholder:


- Prioritize and complete own workload to meet SLA requirements for service and productivity
- Actively maintain understanding of internal and industry regulations and trends, developing and sharing knowledge of emerging issues/risks, and assess potential impacts as it relates to operating policies, standards and procedures
- Consistently exercise discretion in managing correspondence, information and all matters of confidentiality
- Analyze service delivery issues and conduct internal/external research projects and/or contribute to audit reviews; run testing, and generate reports to identify potential solutions within TD's risk appetite that enhance the customer experience and support business objectives
- Support development and/or implementation of standards, policies, procedures, and solutions that mitigate risk and maximize availability of service, efficiency and effectiveness
- Contribute to the development/delivery of presentations/ communications to management or broader audiences
- Protect the interests of the organization - identify and manage risks, and ensure the prompt and thorough resolution of escalated non-standard, high risk issues
- Adhere to enterprise frameworks and methodologies that relate to operations activities for own area (e.g. Anti-Money Laundering, Business Continuity Management)
- Support change management projects or programs that impact the business, functions or processes and ensure clear communication and documentation of new processes




Employee/Team:


- Participate fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure the timely communication of issues/ points of interest
- Support the team by actively building operations knowledge, think critically about processes and opportunities for improvement, share ideas and transfer knowledge within the team, across the function, and with partners (e.g., audit, business insights)
- Provide training, coaching and / or guidance to others on the team
- Participate in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team and other teams in the operations function
- Ensure the timely communication of issues that are relevant to the team and encourage a good working relationship with other departments
- Keep others informed and up-to-date about the status / progress of projects and / or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities
- Contribute to the success of the team by willingly assisting others in the completion and performance of work activities; provide training, coaching and/or guidance as appropriate
- Contribute to a fair, positive and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce
- Act as a brand ambassador for the function and the bank, both internally and/or externally




Breadth & Depth


- Works within broad and/or non- standard parameters, involving multiple steps, systems, and jurisdictions and where there could be a lack of market standard/ practice, referring to a more senior role when necessary
- Accountable for resolving exceptions, non- standard issues / transactions and/or escalating to appropriate level where further clarity or interpretation of more complex policies or rules is required
- Transactions are characterized by low to moderate risk/financial impact
- Low to moderate decision-making authority within defined parameters
- Provides process / policy guidance to others - internal partners and external customers
- May act as a primary coordinator on small scale initiatives or work stream packages for assigned area
- Focus of work is daily, weekly, monthly and/or longer with addition of ad-hoc and initiative-based requests, as required
- Requires advanced knowledge of business unit and operational functions for business area supported and regulatory issues/ requirements for jurisdictions supported
- May interact with cross-functional teams and/or involving external contacts
- Generally reports to a Team Manager




JOB REQUIREMENTS



We're proud to work with a group of diverse colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn't mentioned

below, tell us about it in your resume or cover letter.


- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree in Business/Commerce or related field
- Must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree with the intent of going back to school at the start of your work term (requirement of all co-op/intern positions)

L’analyste d’affaires fera le pont entre les besoins d’affaires et les systèmes d’entreprise essentiels de Medisca — notamment les plateformes CRM et ERP — au sein d’une organisation réglementée et multi-entités. Ce rôle consiste à diriger la collecte des exigences, la cartographie des processus et la conception de solutions pour les projets de mise en œuvre, d’amélioration et d’intégration de systèmes, en collaboration étroite avec les TI, les opérations et les parties prenantes d’affaires, afin de s’assurer que nos plateformes répondent à de véritables besoins d’affaires plutôt que de simplement automatiser les inefficacités existantes.



L'opportunité



Responsabilités Et Fonctions :

- Soutenir la gestion du changement ainsi que la formation et la documentation des utilisateurs finaux pour les nouveaux processus et changements de systèmes
- Maintenir la documentation des processus d’affaires et la traçabilité des exigences à travers les projets
- Contribuer à la gouvernance de projet : rapports d’état, suivi des risques et enjeux, et communication avec les parties prenantes

- Baccalauréat, ou expérience équivalente, en administration des affaires, systèmes d’information ou domaine connexe

- Partner with site managers and operational teams to improve production efficiency, asset utilization, turnaround times, and cost management.

- Provide analytical support for ad hoc projects related to operational performance and network efficiency across Quebec Recycling.






Qualifications



To join our team:





- Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- 2–5 years of experience in operations analysis, industrial performance monitoring, logistics, or a related analytical role.

- Experience in manufacturing, industrial, supply chain, or asset-intensive, multi-site environments, is preferred.

- Strong understanding of operational cost structures and performance drivers, including logistics-related components.

- Proven experience in KPI monitoring, variance analysis, and performance reporting.

- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, advanced formulas, data structuring); experience with Power BI or similar BI tools is an asset.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
- Proactive and autonomous, with the ability to work in a dynamic operational environment.

- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

- High level of professionalism and confidentiality.
- Bilingual (French and English).





Additional Information



What we offer :





- Competitive salary + other benefits;
- Group insurance coverage from day one and group RRSP with employer matching contributions;
- Telemedicine (Unlimited access to a doctor 24/7);
- Eligible for paid vacation from day one; **

Position Description:

Business Analyst



About the Role

The team is seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst who is passionate about automation, governance, and responsible innovation. You will play a critical role in ensuring that every automation, application, and AI use case entering our pipeline is complete, compliant, and aligned with client's governance standards before progressing through security, privacy, and stakeholder approvals.



As the bridge between business stakeholders, citizen developers, platform teams, and governance groups, you will help transform ideas into scalable, secure solutions while protecting the organization against application sprawl, duplicate solutions, inconsistent data practices, unmanaged integrations, and security risks.



This role combines business analysis, governance oversight, stakeholder management, and Power Platform expertise. Success requires strong analytical skills, the ability to challenge assumptions, and the confidence to hold teams accountable to established governance processes.

Your future duties and responsibilities:

What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Intake, Analysis & Qualification

. Analyze, document, and evaluate automation, application, and AI use cases submitted to program.

. Work closely with requestors to understand business objectives, current state processes, expected benefits, and success measures.

. Ensure all required information is complete, accurate, and validated before a use case progresses to the next stage.

. Review use case documentation, business requirements, audience definitions, ownership information, and supporting artifacts to ensure they are governance ready.

. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, or potential risks early in the intake process.

. Challenge assumptions and ensure the proposed solution aligns with business needs and platform capabilities.

2. Governance & Compliance Oversight

. Act as a governance gatekeeper throughout the intake and approval lifecycle.

. Prepare and coordinate deliverables required for security, privacy, compliance, architecture, and governance reviews.

. Ensure all use cases comply with Client standards, Power Platform governance requirements, and enterprise policies.

. Provide clear direction to business teams on governance expectations and approval requirements.

. Prevent unsupported, non compliant, or high risk implementations from progressing without appropriate mitigation.

. Promote responsible adoption of automation, AI, and low code technologies while balancing innovation and risk management.

3. Power Platform & Delivery Enablement

. Leverage your understanding of Microsoft's Power Platform ecosystem, including:


o Power Automate

o Power Apps

o Power BI

o Copilot Studio

. Collaborate with platform administrators and technical teams regarding:

o Environment strategy

o Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies

o Connector governance

o Security and access management

o Licensing considerations

. Support the development and continuous improvement of intake processes, approval workflows, and governance practices.

. Contribute insights that improve platform adoption while maintaining enterprise controls.

4. Stakeholder Management & Delivery Coordination

. Serve as the primary liaison between business units, citizen developers, platform teams, CorpSec, and governance stakeholders.

. Build strong relationships and establish credibility with stakeholders across the organization.

. Drive accountability and ensure stakeholders complete required activities in a timely manner.

. Follow up proactively with requestors to obtain missing information and keep initiatives moving forward.

. Facilitate discussions, resolve ambiguities, and guide teams toward compliant solutions.

. Communicate complex governance and technical concepts in a way that is easily understood by non technical audiences.

5. Risk Identification & Continuous Improvement

. Assess proposed solutions for security, compliance, operational, and adoption risks.

. Recommend enterprise compliant approaches and alternatives when risks are identified.

. Define and track key intake and governance metrics, including:

o Intake cycle time

o Approval lead time

o Compliance completeness

o Rejection and remediation rates

o Throughput and adoption metrics

. Identify opportunities to streamline governance processes while maintaining appropriate controls.

. Contribute to the ongoing maturity and evolution of Client's Automation at program.

6. Education & Responsible Adoption

. Educate business users and citizen developers on governance expectations, best practices, and platform standards.

. Promote responsible automation and AI adoption across the organization.

. Help teams understand not only what requirements exist, but why they matter.

. Foster a culture where innovation, security, compliance, and operational excellence coexist.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

Qualifications

Experience

. 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Process Analyst, or similar role.

. Proven experience gathering requirements, analyzing business processes, and documenting business needs.

. Experience working in governance, compliance, security, risk management, digital transformation, or enterprise technology environments.

. Experience navigating large, complex organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Technical Skills

. Strong understanding of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.

. Familiarity with application development concepts, integrations, data management, and automation technologies.

. Understanding of governance, security, privacy, risk management, and compliance principles.

. Knowledge of low code/no code development and Citizen Development programs.

. Experience with Power Platform governance frameworks, CoE practices, DLP policies, or environment lifecycle management is considered an asset.

. Experience working alongside professional development teams is considered an asset.

________________________________________Key Competencies

. Exceptional analytical and problem solving abilities.

. Strong attention to detail and quality.

. Ability to identify missing information and ask the right questions.

. Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.

. Comfortable enforcing governance requirements while maintaining positive working relationships.

. Strong organizational and follow through skills.

. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

. Ability to balance innovation, velocity, pragmatism, and governance rigor.

. Self starter with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership.



What Sets You Apart

. You naturally seek to understand the "why" behind every request.

. You are comfortable challenging use cases when information is incomplete or risks have not been adequately addressed.

. You know how to navigate organizational complexity and bring stakeholders together toward a common objective.

. You have the confidence to enforce governance standards while remaining a trusted advisor.

. You understand that governance is not about creating barriers; it is about enabling safe, scalable, and sustainable innovation.

. You are passionate about helping organizations realize the full value of automation and AI while ensuring security, compliance, and operational excellence.



Language Requirements

Bilingualism (French and English) is required for this position. The successful candidate will regularly collaborate with colleagues and business stakeholders across Canada in both official languages.

The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $70,000–$135,000. This role is an existing vacancy.



#LI-RD12

Utiliser des outils et des techniques de visualisation de données afin de présenter efficacement les analyses et constats.

Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe de gestion des produits afin de soutenir les objectifs d’affaires.



Effectuer des analyses de données à grande échelle afin de générer des constats exploitables.



Identifier les occasions d’amélioration au moyen d’analyses ponctuelles et de l’évaluation des tendances afin d’améliorer les KPI.



Soutenir les parties prenantes de l’entreprise dans la prise de décisions éclairées et fondées sur les données.



Assurer la disponibilité, l’exactitude et la performance des rapports destinés aux utilisateurs internes et externes.



Fournir un soutien en matière de rapports et d’analytique, au besoin.



Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la qualité des rapports.

Piloter des initiatives d’automatisation des tâches afin d’améliorer l’efficacité et la productivité.

Solides compétences en SQL et expérience dans l’interrogation de jeux de données volumineux et complexes.



Expérience en intelligence d’affaires (BI), en processus ETL et en analytique.



Expérience en programmation analytique avec Python.



Connaissance de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et du fret international, un atout.



Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes, les partenaires externes et les clients.



Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements dynamiques et à s’adapter aux besoins et exigences d’affaires changeants.



Solides compétences en organisation, planification et gestion du temps, avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches et de respecter les échéances.



Solides capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.



Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en maintenant une collaboration efficace au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles.



YOUR ROLE



Work with stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights and contribute to the continuous improvement of performance indicators.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Collaborate closely with the Product Management team to support business objectives.

Identify opportunities through ad hoc analysis and trend evaluation to improve KPIs.



Support business stakeholders in making informed, data-driven decisions.



Ensure the availability, accuracy, and performance of reports for internal and external users.



Provide reporting and analytics support as required.



Contribute to the continuous improvement of report quality.



Deliver training and guidance to users on generating ad hoc reports.



Drive task automation initiatives to improve efficiency and productivity.



Travel as required based on departmental and project needs.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proficiency in data visualization tools, preferably PowerBI.



Strong SQL skills with experience querying large and complex datasets.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams, external partners, and customers.

About The Role



We're looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our growing Operation Performance Analytics (OPA) team, where collaboration, creativity and high impact projects are at the heart of our mandate.



OPA is a national analytics team dedicated to delivering insights and analysis that support Intact Insurance in enhancing operational excellence, driving productivity, fostering growth and elevating service quality across underwriting teams.



What You’ll Do Here





- Collaborate in defining business requirements and develop relevant KPIs aligned with objectives.
- Apply best practices in data preparation to ensure data quality and usability. Deliver high-quality and robust code.

What You Bring To The Table





- Bachelor’s degree in data-related field (i.e., Business intelligence, Mathematics, Science, Statistics, Computer Science, etc.), or any combination of equivalent education and experience.
- 3+ years of relevant work experience.
- Demonstrate strong knowledge of programming languages (Python, SAS an asset) and understanding of underlying data pipelines and workflows.
- Excellent time management and organization skills, managing competing priorities to meet deadlines.
- Demonstrate ownership and accountability for deliverables.
- Bilingualism (French / English) – Need to interact on a regular basis with colleagues across the country.

- Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.

- Strong expertise in Power BI (star schema modeling, advanced DAX, security, and deployment).
- Excellent proficiency in SQL and experience with Google BigQuery.
- Solid proficiency in Python for advanced analytics and automation.
- Ability to understand business challenges and translate requirements into structured analytical solutions.
- Excellent communication skills in both French and English, spoken and written. In this role, you will regularly collaborate with internal clients across Canada.

Our head office is full of opportunities for professionals from a variety of sectors: information technology, human resources, accounting, sales and marketing, and distribution. A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe.

Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including Software and Red Hat.



Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.



About Business Unit



IBM Consulting is IBM’s consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients’ businesses through the power of collaboration. We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners and the planet.



Your Role And Responsibilities



Our team is seeking candidates with strong analytical thinking, a passion for solving business problems, and an interest in leveraging AI and automation to drive impact. We’re looking for individuals who enjoy structuring problems, coordinating teams, and telling compelling stories with data.



The successful candidate will join a fast-paced consulting team composed of Partners, Product Managers, Data Scientists, Architects, and Software Engineers. In this role, you will help plan, coordinate, and support the delivery of AI-driven solutions to solve enterprise-scale challenges. You’ll act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment, clarity, and measurable outcomes.



As a Business Analyst Intern, you will contribute to project planning, requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, and presentation of insights. You’ll gain exposure to industry-leading technologies and AI initiatives on cloud platforms (e.g., IBM Cloud, Azure), while helping translate complex technical work into clear business value.



Key Responsibilities Include





- Supporting project planning, timelines, and deliverables across multiple engagements
- Gathering and documenting business requirements and translating them into actionable tasks
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business needs and technical solutions
- Preparing presentations, reports, and client-ready materials to communicate insights and progress
- Assisting in identifying opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business processes
- Tracking project performance and helping ensure successful delivery against objectives





You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives are valued, and where team members are encouraged to take initiative, think critically, and contribute to meaningful outcomes for clients.



This position resides in Montreal and is a 4-month work term commencing in January 2027. All applicants must be eligible to work full-time in Canada and enrolled full-time in an eligible post-secondary program. It is mandatory that applicants return to full-time studies upon completion of the work term. Candidates pursuing Bachelor's or Master's degrees are eligible. MBA and PhD candidates are not eligible for this opportunity.

Bachelor's Degree

- Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly present ideas, insights, and recommendations to peers and stakeholders
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams
- Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.





Preferred Technical And Professional Experience





- Previous internship or project experience in business analysis, consulting, project coordination, or a related role

- Experience creating presentations and reports using tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, or similar

joue un rôle clé dans la production d’informations financières exactes, opportunes et pertinentes pour plusieurs entités nord-américaines. - Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et de la modélisation financière.

Senior Financial Analyst, BI Reporting



At IPEX, the leader in thermoplastic piping systems, we are redefining the future of water management and clean energy. As part of the Aliaxis family, we combine global strength with local expertise to tackle the world's toughest challenges. - Develop and maintain advanced management reports and dashboards for senior leadership.
- Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Power BI semantic models supporting Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, and Operational reporting.

- Monitor dataset performance and optimize reporting environments.
- Automate Finance processes including approvals, notifications, reconciliations, reporting distribution, and recurring controls.
- Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
- Ensure accuracy and compliance in multi-currency and intercompany transactions.
- Drive ERP system transitions and enhancements, ensuring data integrity and process optimization.
- Lead process improvements focused on efficiency, automation, and scalability.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams on strategic initiatives and special projects.
- Conduct ad hoc financial analyses supporting business decision-making.
- Mentor and support junior financial analysts.





Education & Experience





- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance (CPA preferred).
- 4-6 years of progressive experience in financial reporting, analysis, or related fields.





Technical Skills





- Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling expertise.
- Advanced Power BI experience including Semantic Models, DAX, Power Query, Incremental Refresh, and RLS.
- Advanced Microsoft Power Automate development experience.
- Experience with ERP and BI systems including IBM TM1, Cognos Controller, and SAP S/4HANA.
- Knowledge of financial reporting structures, foreign currency, and intercompany accounting.





Core Competencies





- Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
- Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
- High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
- Proactive, adaptable, and solution-oriented mindset





Key Relationships





- Collaborates with Finance, Accounting, Operations, and IT teams.
- Partners with business unit leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations.
- Supports ERP and BI system administrators during upgrades and transitions.





Why Join Us?



This role offers the opportunity to influence business growth, develop strategic customer partnerships, and contribute directly to market expansion within a respected industry-leading organization.



IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at HR@ipexna.com



Join a forward-thinking finance team where data, analytics, and innovation drive business success.

job_description:
What is the opportunity?

Are you interested in working as a Business Analyst Intern on the Chief Legal and Administrative Officer (CLAO) Shared Services Team in the CLAO Group at the Royal Bank of Canada?

RBC's Chief Legal and Administrative Group (CLAO Group)is a critical function within the organization. This group integrates legal, compliance, enterprise strategy, strategic execution of enterprise initiatives, as well as procurement and supplier management, and corporate real estate. In addition, CLAO oversees enterprise controls and data governance to ensure the organization operates ethically, efficiently, and in alignment with regulatory requirements.



Our team is looking for a Business Analyst Intern who is constantly thinking outside the box, ready to dive deep into the smallest details, is passionate about new technologies, research and operational efficiencies!



What will you do?


- Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders (e.g., business units, IT teams) to document business needs, processes, and system requirements related to the effectiveness and efficiency of current processes and systems. Conduct interviews, workshops, or surveys to elicit and clarify requirements.
- Process Mapping & Documentation: Create process flow diagrams and detailed documentation for Operational processes and procedures for CLAO Business Segments (e.g. risks, controls, invoices, corporate memberships, etc.). Are you passionate about data, strategic analysis, and building decision-support tools? We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst who will play an active role in driving the performance and growth of our organization.





Founded in 1892, ROBIC is an internationally renowned firm bringing together professionals with diverse expertise, including lawyers, scientists, and engineers specializing in intellectual property and business law. In 2023, ROBIC joined the IPH Limited group, an international network of intellectual property firms operating across ten jurisdictions and serving clients in more than 25 countries.





Reporting to the Executive Director, Administration and Finance, the successful candidate will play a key role in transforming data into strategic insights that support informed decision-making. This individual will be responsible for developing and monitoring a variety of business analyses and reports. They will identify and define key performance indicators (KPIs), establish performance benchmarks, and develop dashboards to effectively track and communicate organizational performance.





The Business Intelligence Analyst will work closely with the Human Resources team, directors, and supervisors across the firm, acting as a trusted partner in delivering meaningful insights and recommendations. This strategic role offers a unique opportunity to create significant value and contribute directly to the firm's continued success and growth.





WHY JOIN THE ROBIC TEAM?


- To be part of a people-focused and dynamic team;
- To have a meaningful impact within a firm that is constantly evolving and open to new ideas;
- To enjoy a flexible work schedule that supports work-life balance;
- To have the option to work remotely up to 3 days per week;
- To benefit from every second Friday off year-round through a time-banking program;
- To access a wide range of employee benefits, including group insurance, RRSP plan with employer contribution, sick days, years of service recognition program, peer recognition programs, vacation days available from day one, telemedicine services for you and your family, an employee assistance program, OPUS discount, a free on-site gym, and more;
- To work in a bright, fully renovated office space that is easily accessible by public transit, with complimentary coffee available at all times;
- To collaborate with some of the most respected lawyers, engineers, and scientists in intellectual property in Canada;
- To join an employer recognized among the Best Workplaces in Professional Services nationwide, and certified as a Great Place to Work for the past three consecutive years.








Responsibilities





- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports that provide managers with meaningful insights to support informed decision-making
- Transform data from multiple sources into strategic business intelligence and provide recommendations aimed at improving organizational performance
- Gather business requirements and translate them into effective Business Intelligence (BI) solutions
- Participate in the automation and optimization of reporting processes and analytical workflows
- Ensure data integrity, quality, and governance across reporting and analytics activities
- Identify and develop key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workload, productivity, and role-specific responsibilities, and provide actionable recommendations based on findings
- Identify opportunities for improvement within Power BI analyses and communicate recommendations, as appropriate, to team leaders and supervisors
- Analyze and compare actual results against established performance benchmarks to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for enhancement
- Perform other related duties involving data analysis, reporting, and continuous process improvement.








Requirements and skills





- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence, Management, or a related field
- Strong data analysis skills with the ability to interpret complex information and generate actionable insights
- Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a role involving data analysis and reporting
- Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and spoken
- Proficiency in Power BI
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Knowledge of Power Query, Power Pivot, Power Automate, SQL Server, DAX, and Microsoft Fabric (an asset)
- Knowledge of process improvement methodologies (an asset)
- Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify issues and opportunities, and draw meaningful conclusions;
- Strong ability to communicate complex information clearly and concisely to a variety of stakeholders
- Leadership skills and a proactive mindset
- Strategic thinking and strong critical-thinking abilities
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment





We are looking for a standout candidate who will bring strategic expertise to support ROBIC’s continued growth and evolution. We offer a comprehensive range of distinctive benefits, flexibility to allow a work-life balance, all within a warm and stimulating work environment.

Job Description



The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end Targeted campaigns supporting the growing needs of a portfolio within the broader
Marketing, Digital, Social and Content group. Marketing, Digital, Social and Content supports the central marketing function within TD Bank Group and TDI with high quality, innovative, and insightful information to help build value for our customers and shareholders. Marketing, Digital, Social and Content is a North America centre of excellence located in Toronto, with satellite offices in Ottawa (MBNA brand) and New Jersey (TD Bank America's Most Convenient Bank). It supports most consumer facing TD Bank Group and TDI lines of business.



Your goal as a part of the Marketing Delivery team is to design, execute and measure performance of campaigns to drive acquisition, retention, engagement across the portfolio. If you are driven by helping stakeholders understand data, love when the latest direct-to-consumer marketing campaign results are available, and continually strive to challenge the "process status quo" to make work flows run as efficiently as possible – this is the role for you.



Success In This Role Will Be Achieved By



Translating key business objectives into insight rich experiments that drive marketing ROI Ensuring
execution (i.e., list creation) is done efficiently and with excellence Providing
high value post-campaign reporting that derives insights



Your success will be predicated on your ability to forge strong partnerships, communicate effectively, deliver on-time, and continuously strive for increased efficiency.



Responsibilities





- Design/execute/measure high impact direct to consumer marketing experiments
- Proactively provide analytical guidance to key stakeholders, based on deep understanding of the businesses, to understand and enhance marketing ROI
- Work in DataBricks, use SQL as one of the main programing languages.
- Work closely with Integrated Marketing to design, streamline and optimize Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) journeys, including building and filtering audiences in Salesforce CDC.
- Build and deploy marketing campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud utilizing Email Studio, Automation Studio, and Journey Builder, thus including development of journeys, template setup, list management, form creations, A/B testing and automated triggers.
- Design and execute cross-channel SFMC campaigns / journeys based on Marketer requirements.
- Lead the configuration of audience entry source, exit criteria, re-entry criteria based on campaign goals, structures Journey decision splits
- Oversee journey planning and execution including technical reviews and quality control.
- Build and maintain modular campaign template(s) that are responsive and incorporate brand standards and best practices.
- Perform QA testing to ensure segmented audiences and content are accurate and rendering properly on different devices.
- Manage and segment audience data using the various Marketing Cloud tools (audience builder, data extensions, API, filters, queries, etc.).
- Troubleshoot campaign development issues including template rendering, accurate links, accessibility, subscriber lookup, etc.).
- Leverages SFMC tools and scripting languages to update content and enable dynamic content/personalization.
- Build highly dynamic campaigns using HTML and AMPscript.
- Provide guidance and train specialists on basic SFMC capabilities and deployment best practices.
- Bring expertise in personalization and marketing automation around dynamic email content and segmentation rules to customize marketing campaigns
- Participate in campaign optimization sessions and support analysis of campaign performance
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams achieve campaign objectives in the stated timelines
- Utilize strong project management skills to drive initiatives from conception to completion within established timelines
- Continuously improve campaign design and delivery by leveraging any and all analytical tools/techniques at your disposal
- Execute with excellence
- Manage your project pipeline to ensure agreed upon timelines can be met
- Maintain a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes and sound infrastructure





Skill Sets





- Minimum 3+ years of SQL. Be capable of understanding and programing complex SQL code.
- Minimum 2+ years of Salesforce and Marketing Cloud automation experience.
- Solid CRM experience and understanding of marketing campaign concepts and best practices
- Solid experience owning multi-audience campaigns, and extensive usage of Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) required, inclusive of Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, and Data Extensions,
- Proficient in AMPscript, HTML/CSS, and dynamic content scripting for email customization.
- Experience creating dynamic and personalized marketing campaigns using AMPscript and SQL expertise, building automations for marketing, analysis, and system maintenance using SQL knowledge, maintaining and optimizing SFMC for peak performance and data integrity.
- Strong knowledge of CASL and other regulatory frameworks applicable to email marketing in Canada.
- Ability to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Excellent attention to detail and quality control in execution and deployment
- Pragmatic decision maker blending a mix of intellect, experience and street smarts
- A profit driven mindset
- A passion for campaign analytics
- Experience with Agile methodologies and a zest for the agile mindset
- A project management mindset to help deliver on time to specifications
- Technical and detail oriented





Qualifications





- Experience in SQL (3+ years) and Salesforce (2+ years in Marketing Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud Engagement).
- 2+ years of journey orchestration experience in Financial Services or other regulated industry
- 2+ years of experience working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment with a track record of effectively working autonomously and navigating ambiguity
- Additional assets (nice to have)

- Knowledge of Python
- Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications: Administrator, Developer, and/or Email Specialist





Who We Are



TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.



Our Total Rewards Package



Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more



Additional Information



We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.



Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.



Colleague Development



If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.



If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.



We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.



Training & Onboarding



We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.



Interview Process



We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.



Accommodation



Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.



We look forward to hearing from you!

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, to play a key role in advancing our data culture and analytical capabilities.

job_description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.



Join our team and what we’ll accomplish together



The DB Implementation Team at TELUS Health is a dynamic group of nearly 300 skilled and motivated professionals, working together to deliver the most competitive integrated systems solutions available. We design, implement, and support a comprehensive DB pension administration solution for large public sector clients.



Our solution stands out due to the proactive and creative contributions of each team member, including business analysts, developers, QA analysts, project managers, and solution designers. We thrive in a dynamic, Agile-driven development environment, fostering collaboration throughout the implementation process and in the ongoing services we provide to our clients.



If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a positive impact on our clients and their pension plan members, this is the perfect role for you!



Here’s the impact you’ll make and what we’ll accomplish together



In this role, you will play a crucial role in delivering integrated pension administration solutions to large public sector clients. You will gather and analyze client requirements, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure successful implementation of our comprehensive solution. You will work closely with solution architects, functional leads, developers, and quality assurance teams to create innovative solutions that meet complex business needs. This position offers extensive exposure to multiple business modules including Pension, Health & Welfare, Payroll, and Finance.



What’s In It For You







- 100% work from home arrangement with travel requirements for essential meetings
- Long-term, enterprise-level project engagement with extensive exposure to multiple business modules (Pension, Health & Welfare, Payroll, Finance)
- Rich mix of internal and external client interactions and a dynamic, collaborative team driving innovation in our industry
- Comprehensive customizable benefits package to suit your unique needs and lifestyle
- Paid vacation days & well-being days as well as a well-being expense account to help maintain a better work/life balance
- Various investment options such as employee share purchase plan, group RRSP & TFSA, and DC pension plan
- Generous mental health support account to cover the cost of therapy/counseling sessions







What you'll do:







- Gather and analyze client requirements for the implementation of our integrated solution
- Document business and operational needs within the context of implementation and workflow automation
- Evaluate and map business processes, aligning them with the data used across various pension plan management systems (e.g., payroll system, pension calculations, financial transactions, document management, telephony)
- Collaborate with solution architects, functional leads, and the development team to create and review new solutions
- Define testing scope and criteria and work closely with the quality assurance team during execution
- Contribute to the creation or redesign of reports and communications that support processes and procedures
- Provide ongoing follow-up with stakeholders regarding implemented changes







You have:







- A degree in administration, computer science, actuarial mathematics, business analysis, or a related field
- Minimum 5 years of experience in a relevant area, such as pension plan management, workflow management system implementation, or administrative process automation
- Proficiency in current computer technologies
- Experience in using Excel and the Microsoft Office suite







What you bring:







- Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information, understand, systematize, and communicate technical concepts clearly
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- Available to travel as needed







Nice to Have:







- Experience with pension administration software systems
- Bilingualism would be considered an asset







Salary Range: $58,100 - $107,900 CAD Annual



Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.



TELUS offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:







- Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
- Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
- Generous company matched pension
- Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
- Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills
- And much more…







Job Type: This is for a current vacancy



A Bit About Us



We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.



TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.
